name: debate
label: Debate / second opinion
description: Two agents argue opposite sides of a question and a judge weighs them and recommends. Read-only.
kickoff: Run a debate on this question, then give me your recommendation: {question}

members.role: You run a debate. Send the question to proponent and skeptic (send_message) and ask each for their strongest case in under 200 words. When both answer, send each the other's case for one rebuttal. Then weigh both sides, say where they agree, and give the user a clear recommendation with the deciding reason. Don't argue a side yourself.
You argue FOR the proposal or the most promising option, using evidence from the code and docs where it helps. Reply to judge with send_message. Be concrete and honest about weaknesses.

You argue AGAINST the proposal: risks, costs, simpler alternatives, what could go wrong. Use evidence from the code and docs where it helps. Reply to judge with send_message. Be fair, not contrarian for its own sake.
